Website maintenance & support

Website Maintenance Services That Keep Your Site Fast and Secure

Your website is never really finished. We handle the updates, backups, security checks, fixes and content changes that keep it working properly — so you can focus on running your business.

Get a Website Health CheckCall 94459 78150

01Overview

Ongoing care for your business website

Websites need regular attention. Software needs updates, SSL certificates need renewing, forms need testing and content needs to reflect your current services, prices and contact details. Left alone, small issues become broken pages, security problems or lost enquiries.

Our website maintenance service gives you a dependable person to call when something needs changing, plus routine checks that catch problems before your customers do. We maintain websites we have built, and sites built by others after an initial health check.

Maintenance pairs naturally with SEO — a healthy, up-to-date website gives your search visibility a solid foundation. Planning something bigger? A website redesign may cost less than repeatedly patching an old site.

Helpful if

  • You don't have a web personAnd changes wait weeks or never happen.
  • Your developer has moved onLeaving nobody who knows how the site works.
  • You worry about securityOr have had spam, hacks or downtime before.
  • Your content changes oftenNew services, offers, staff or projects to add.

02Problems we solve

Problems regular maintenance prevents

Security vulnerabilities

Outdated software and plugins are one of the most common ways websites get compromised.

Broken forms and links

An enquiry form that stops working can cost weeks of leads before anyone notices.

Slowing performance

Growing image libraries, unused plugins and old code gradually slow a site down.

Outdated information

Old prices, discontinued services or a previous phone number confuse customers and damage trust.

03What's included

What our maintenance service includes

Software and plugin updates

Core, theme and plugin updates applied carefully and tested, where your platform needs them.

Regular backups

Scheduled backups of your files and content, so the site can be restored if something goes wrong.

Security monitoring

SSL checks, spam protection and security reviews to keep threats out.

Uptime and form checks

Monitoring that your site is online and that enquiry forms still deliver.

Speed tuning

Image optimisation and performance checks to keep pages loading quickly.

Content changes

Text, image, price and page updates handled for you on request.

04Benefits

Peace of mind for your online presence

Maintenance is insurance for your website. Preventing problems costs far less than recovering a hacked site or explaining to customers why their enquiry never got a reply.

  • Fewer surprisesIssues spotted and fixed before they affect customers.
  • A faster, safer siteRegular updates and performance checks.
  • Quick changesUpdates handled without hunting for a developer.
  • Protected search visibilityDowntime and errors can hurt rankings; monitoring helps prevent them.

05Our process

How website maintenance works

  1. Health check

    We review your website's software, security, speed, backups and forms.

  2. Fix urgent issues

    Critical problems are resolved first and the site is backed up.

  3. Agree a care plan

    The checks, update frequency and content changes that suit your site.

  4. Ongoing maintenance

    Routine updates, backups and monitoring on an agreed schedule.

  5. Regular summaries

    A short report of what was checked, updated and fixed.

08FAQs

Website maintenance FAQs

Can you maintain my website after launch?

Yes. Maintenance is available for every website we build, and we can take on websites built by others after an initial health check.

What if my website was built by someone else?

We start with a health check to understand the platform, hosting, access and any existing problems. Then we recommend a care plan — or, if the site is in poor shape, explain your options.

How quickly can you make changes to my website?

Routine content changes are handled promptly, and urgent issues such as a broken page or form are prioritised. We agree response expectations in your care plan.

Do you offer website redesign as well?

Yes. If maintaining an older site no longer makes sense, we can plan a redesign that keeps your existing content and search visibility where possible.

Does a static website need maintenance?

Static websites need far less maintenance than database-driven ones, but content updates, domain and SSL renewals, form checks and occasional improvements still matter.
